description.value: Maar's Burger Bar is a craft burger joint at Cultus Lake founded by two brothers who grew up on the lake and set out to bring quality food to an area they felt was underserved. The menu features locally sourced ingredients from BC suppliers including Old Yale Brewing, Anita's Organics buns, and an award-winning butcher. For a touring cyclist, it offers a fast, filling stop with burgers, craft beer, wine, and a focused menu of sides.

address.value: 4125 Columbia Valley Highway, Cultus Lake, V2R 5B7
